projects.name: enterprise-ai-rag-agentic-workflow
projects.description: An agentic RAG assistant that answers questions over 10K enterprise documents with hybrid retrieval and reranking, calling internal REST APIs as tools to complete multi-step workflows. An evaluation harness with a 200-question golden set tracks retrieval hit rate, grounding, and latency, improving answer accuracy from 68% to 86%; deployed on AWS at p95 latency under 2 s.

projects.name: ml-production-model-deployment
projects.description: A transformer classifier fine-tuned on 40K labeled samples for document routing, reaching 0.89 macro-F1 versus 0.78 for a scikit-learn TF-IDF baseline. Served through FastAPI on Kubernetes with an MLflow model registry, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and drift monitoring that triggers retraining, keeping production F1 within 2 points of offline results.

projects.name: ai_soc
projects.description: A local AI security operations center: Wazuh-format alert ingestion, ML flow classification, LLM triage with Ollama, retrieval over security knowledge (RAG), incident correlation, analyst review with role-based accounts, Sigma rule export, and dry-run response plans.

projects.name: driftguard
projects.description: A self-monitoring ML lifecycle: train, track and register with MLflow, serve with FastAPI, detect drift (PSI and KS, feature vs concept drift), then auto-retrain and promote. On a real 2011→2012 demand shift it detects concept drift and cuts held-out MAE by 44.6%.

projects.name: email-phishing-detection
projects.description: Analyzes .eml and .msg emails for phishing using header authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), URL and typosquatting checks, attachment hashing, OCR on images, async VirusTotal lookups, and an LLM assessment that returns a structured phishing score and verdict.

projects.name: creditcardfrauddetection-mlops
projects.description: Credit card fraud detection with Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost models, DVC-versioned data, a Flask app for risk-segmented predictions, and LangChain-generated natural-language explanations of each result, containerized with Docker.

projects.name: text-analysis-using-nlp-streamlit
projects.description: An interactive Streamlit app for NLP text analysis: preprocessing, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging, and word clouds, with adjustable parameters for each task.
